# Respire documentation

> Official English and Simplified Chinese guides for Respire, a local-first memory layer for AI tools, the rsrs CLI, desktop client and encrypted synchronization.

## Getting started

- [Documentation overview](https://docs.rsrs.rs/): Product components, responsibilities and links to core guides.
- [Getting started](https://docs.rsrs.rs/getting-started): Install the desktop client, connect the Runtime, connect an AI tool and create a memory.
- [Standalone CLI installation](https://docs.rsrs.rs/cli-install): Install and verify the rsrs CLI for terminal workflows.
- [CLI commands](https://docs.rsrs.rs/cli): Memory, synchronization, runtime and administration commands.
- [Walkthrough](https://docs.rsrs.rs/walkthrough): A practical introduction to the main Respire workflows.
- [Desktop client](https://docs.rsrs.rs/client): Interface, account, model, integration and diagnostics guide.
- [Frequently asked questions](https://docs.rsrs.rs/faq): Answers about accounts, security, models, injection and version compatibility.

## AI tool integrations

- [AI tool plugins](https://docs.rsrs.rs/plugins/): Compare supported hosts, install adapters and configure recall and storage.
- [AI tool injection](https://docs.rsrs.rs/injection): Configure managed instructions and understand the scope of injected context.
- [Plugin development](https://docs.rsrs.rs/plugin-dev): Build host integrations using supported Respire interfaces.

## Architecture and development

- [Architecture](https://docs.rsrs.rs/architecture): Local storage, retrieval, encryption and synchronization data flow.
- [Data model](https://docs.rsrs.rs/data-model): Memory records, categories, associations and state.
- [Sync and keys](https://docs.rsrs.rs/sync-and-keys): Encryption, identity, device keys and synchronization boundaries.
- [Development](https://docs.rsrs.rs/development): Repository setup, build prerequisites and verification.
- [Repositories](https://docs.rsrs.rs/repos): Official Respire source repositories and their responsibilities.

## 中文文档

- [文档概览](https://docs.rsrs.rs/zh/): Respire 组件、职责与核心指南入口。
- [开始使用](https://docs.rsrs.rs/zh/getting-started): 安装客户端、连接 Runtime、配置 AI 工具并创建记忆。
- [AI 工具插件](https://docs.rsrs.rs/zh/plugins/): 各 AI 宿主的安装、配置和故障排查指南。
- [架构](https://docs.rsrs.rs/zh/architecture): 本地存储、检索、加密和同步的数据流。

## Official links

- [Respire website](https://rsrs.rs/): Product overview, download links and official channels.
- [GitHub organization](https://github.com/risense-ai): Official Respire source code and releases.
